title: JSONPlaceholder Posts
description: Fetches all 100 sample posts from JSONPlaceholder - a free fake REST API for testing and prototyping. No API key required. Great for verifying your ingestion pipeline works end-to-end.
code:
import pandas as pd
import requests
from datetime import datetime, timezone

# JSONPlaceholder - free fake REST API
# https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/
response = requests.get('https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts', timeout=30)
response.raise_for_status()
posts = response.json()

df = pd.DataFrame(posts)

# Add a timestamp since the API doesn't provide one
df['_epoch'] = int(datetime.now(timezone.utc).timestamp())

# Rename columns for clarity
df = df.rename(columns={'userId': 'user_id'})

GENERATE_RESULTS(df)
